name: chess-game

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build:desktop: cd client && npx vite build && cd .. && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:win: cd client && npx vite build && cd .. && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: cd client && npx vite build && cd .. && electron-builder --mac
scripts.sync:mobile: cd client && npx vite build && npx cap sync
scripts.apk: cd client && npx vite build && npx cap sync android && cd ../mobile/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug

description: 暗棋象棋 - Hidden Piece Chinese Chess Online
